weights.prompt:
Problem: How should we organize captions for the oral history listening room we're putting together at our local library so visitors can follow the recordings?
Proposed step: Match each caption file to the interview's catalog number so two recordings with similar titles don't end up playing with each other's words.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Problem: How should we organize captions for the oral history listening room we're putting together at our local library so visitors can follow the recordings?
Proposed step: Mark a change of speaker with the name the person agreed to use. A listener who can't distinguish the voices can still follow the exchange.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Problem: How should we organize captions for the oral history listening room we're putting together at our local library so visitors can follow the recordings?
Proposed step: Include a brief description of a meaningful sound, such as the train whistle both speakers stop to hear, when it helps explain their reaction.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Problem: How should we organize captions for the oral history listening room we're putting together at our local library so visitors can follow the recordings?
Proposed step: Time each caption to the relevant phrase so a visitor can connect the words on screen with the same moment in the recording.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Problem: How should we organize captions for the oral history listening room we're putting together at our local library so visitors can follow the recordings?
Proposed step: Break lines at natural points in a sentence and keep a person's first and last name together to make the text easier to take in at a glance.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Problem: How should we organize captions for the oral history listening room we're putting together at our local library so visitors can follow the recordings?
Proposed step: Ask narrators or their nominated reviewers to confirm how people's names and local landmarks are spelled before the captions go on display.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Proposed step: Keep a narrator's own expressions in the captions. A familiar turn of phrase can carry part of the story that a polished rewrite would lose.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Problem: How should we organize captions for the oral history listening room we're putting together at our local library so visitors can follow the recordings?
Proposed step: If two reviewers still can't make out a word, mark it as inaudible so visitors know where the recording leaves a gap in the account.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Proposed step: Identify which languages are spoken and label each available translation by name so visitors can select the text they want.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Problem: How should we organize captions for the oral history listening room we're putting together at our local library so visitors can follow the recordings?
Proposed step: For overlapping conversation, give the two voices separate lines where both are intelligible. Visitors can see that the remarks were made together.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Proposed step: Place captions on a solid, high-contrast background so their legibility survives a shift from a dark portrait to a pale archival photograph.

Proposed step: Put a replay control within easy reach for passages with several names or dates that a visitor may want to read again.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Proposed step: Start a fresh listening session with captions visible so a visitor can read the opening words without searching through settings.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Proposed step: Offer a printed transcript for each recording with the same title as the on-screen listing. People who prefer to read on paper can pick the matching copy.
Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Would this step help achieve the objective? Answer Yes or No.

Problem: How can we keep our public chess room calm while making it a comfortable place for someone still learning the game?
Proposed step: Keep a couple of tables for games where spoken questions are welcome, so a learner can ask about a move without guessing whether their opponent minds.

Problem: How can we keep our public chess room calm while making it a comfortable place for someone still learning the game?

Problem: How can we keep our public chess room calm while making it a comfortable place for someone still learning the game?

Problem: How can we keep our public chess room calm while making it a comfortable place for someone still learning the game?
Proposed step: Silence the beeps on communal clocks so the end of one game doesn't break a neighboring player's concentration.

Problem: How can we keep our public chess room calm while making it a comfortable place for someone still learning the game?
